test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which country is the largest producer of wheat in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The total global wheat production in** 2020 was 760 million tonnes.**
 
• **China, India, and Russia **are the world's three greatest individual wheat producers, accounting for over **41%** of global wheat production.
 
• Individually, the** United States** is the** world's fourth-largest **wheat producer.
 
• Wheat is the** second **most widely grown cereal grain after maize, and its global trade volume exceeds that of all other crops combined.
 
• Major wheat-growing **states in India** are Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar and Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wheat is a principal **rabi crop.**
 
• Wheat plants have long, slender leaves and stems, as well as little flowers grown in** spikelets.**
 
• The portion of the plant taken for food is the **seeds** that develop on these spikelets.
 
• Wheat is the primary source of **vegetable protein** in human meals, with a protein level of around **13%.**
 
• It is also a significant** carbohydrate source.**
 
• Depending on the climate and soil conditions, the crop takes between **110 and 130 days** to mature from seed to harvest.
 
• The crop grows to be between** 2 and 4 feet tall**, with some kinds reaching up to 7 feet tall.
 
• Warmer temperatures** (70° to 75° F) **are ideal for growing the crop.
